spoken_summary: Ken Martin introduces himself as the new Chair of the Democratic National Committee. He outlines three points: 1) his 14 years of experience as chair of the Minnesota DFL, 2) how they used their power in Minnesota to create "generational change," and 3) his plan to expand that model nationwide to "contest races up and down the ballot" and win in every zip code for the party's values.
